payload.reason: The evidence provides comparative performance results of the proposed text smoothing method against other data augmentation methods, indicating significant improvements in accuracy across various datasets.

claims.text: Text smoothing outperforms the previously best method, BARTspan, by 1.17% in average accuracy.
Text smoothing significantly improves baseline data augmentation methods by 5.98%, 2.79%, 2.39%, and more across different techniques.
In low-resource settings, text smoothing achieves better performance than various mainstream data augmentation methods.
